crash_hull.source: Points that hit the ground first (le frame): wing tips (60 in span, slight dihedral), spinner tip (firewall 6.94 in ahead of LE plus engine and spinner), tail end and stabilizer tips (52 in overall length), fin top, belly under the CG (fuselage bottom 0.053 m below the thrust line, from the model team's fuselage stations). Read from the Jensen plan and the visual model. Since E1 the wheels are landing_gear contacts, not hull points: a wheel on the ground is a landing, a leg pushed past its travel is a crash
